claims.text: Montage Palmetto Bluff sits along the May River in South Carolina's Lowcountry, between Hilton Head Island and Savannah.

findings.quote: Nestled along the May River in South Carolina’s Lowcountry, Montage Palmetto Bluff resort is set within a vibrant community between Hilton Head Island and Savannah.

claims.text: Three-quarters of Palmetto Bluff is a protected nature reserve.

findings.quote: Three-quarters of The Bluff, as locals call it, is a protected nature reserve.

claims.text: The resort was formerly The Inn at Palmetto Bluff.

findings.quote: Montage Palmetto Bluff (formerly The Inn at Palmetto Bluff)

claims.text: The resort is in the heart of Wilson Village, where the ruins of the Wilson mansion can still be seen.

findings.quote: Montage Palmetto Bluff is in the heart of Wilson Village, where you can still see the mansion's ruins.

claims.text: Accommodations include cottages, guestrooms, suites and village homes that reflect the Lowcountry's heritage.

findings.quote: Our resort’s collection of spacious cottages, guestrooms, suites and village homes all pay homage to the Lowcountry’s rich heritage.

claims.text: Some of the cottages face the May River.

findings.quote: Then, across the grounds are cottages, some facing the May River.

claims.text: Spa Montage draws on the Coastal Carolina environment for a nature-inspired wellness experience.

findings.quote: Incorporating elements of the Coastal Carolina environment, Spa Montage draws inspiration from nature to create an indigenous wellness experience.

claims.text: The property has an on-site bird conservatory and a Jack Nicklaus-designed golf course.

findings.quote: the property has an on-site bird conservatory, a Jack Nicklaus-designed golf course

claims.text: At the Inn, the Octagon Porch and Bar serve a Southern-inflected menu.

findings.quote: At the Inn, the Octagon Porch and Bar serve a Southern-inflected menu inside and on the porch.

claims.text: Buffalo's, by the main square in Wilson Village, serves a Biscuit Bar at breakfast.

findings.quote: by the main square in Wilson Village, Buffalo's is popular all-day that serves a famous Biscuit Bar at breakfast

claims.text: R.T.'s, the general store, has a deli, wine and local souvenirs.

findings.quote: R.T.'s, the general store, has a fine deli and other treats, wine, classic candy, and local souvenirs.

claims.text: The River House hosts daily porching, with lemonade and cookies served on the screened-in porch.

findings.quote: at the River House (formerly the main Inn), there's daily "porching" at 3:30 p.m., where they serve lemonade and cookies on the screened-in porch

claims.text: The resort has canine ambassadors, dogs that roam the grounds.

findings.quote: It would have to be the canine ambassadors, the resort's set of precious dogs who are constantly roaming the grounds

claims.text: The Inn is modeled after the historic mansion of Richard T. Wilson, a New York multimillionaire.

findings.quote: modeled after the historic mansion of Richard T. Wilson, a New York multimillionaire

claims.text: On-site outfitters arrange boating on the river, island visits, kayaking, tubing and paddleboarding.

findings.quote: tap the on-site outfitters for activities like boating on the river, visiting local islands, dock-jumping, kayaking, tubing, and paddleboarding.

claims.text: Paintbox, the kids' club, has daily activities focused on the natural environment, wildlife and Lowcountry culture.

findings.quote: Paintbox, the kids' club, has daily activities that lean into the resort's natural environment and wildlife, and Low Country culture.

claims.text: Alligators live in the area, so swimming in the river and lagoons is not advised.

findings.quote: You've got riverfront and lagoon access, but don't you dare try to swim: Did we mention that gators live here!

claims.text: Bike paths and golf carts are how guests get around the property.

findings.quote: Bike paths and golf carts are how you get around

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the secluded Lowcountry location requires planned transportation.
